car_note: Excess return scaled by 1/mean gross exposure; the risk-free credit is not levered.
capm_note: Shown only to demonstrate neutrality; not the headline test.
power_statement: Over 5.6 years at 0.11% annualised volatility, the standard error of the mean return is 0.05%/yr. Power to detect a 1.0%/yr edge at alpha=0.05 is 100.0%; the smallest effect detectable at 80% power is 0.13%/yr. A null result here means the design could not resolve an edge of the size sought, not that no edge exists.
